powerName: Require a seized or detained vessel to be brought to a specified port
description: Section 9(2)(b) states that the master of a vessel so seized or detained may be required to bring the vessel to a specified port.
conditions: The vessel must be the vessel so seized or detained under Section 9(2).
limitations: This record does not identify a port or provide an operational direction.
The statutory and jurisdictional conditions must be assessed from verified facts.
source: India Code, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
